name: Aurich (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Aurich (a red gate with towers between trees on white).
history: Municipal flag of Aurich; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Aurich arms — gate between trees on white
